explanation: Engineer Allan Alcorn built it as a practice project set by Atari's co-founder Nolan Bushnell. Each player turns a knob to move a paddle up and down.

claims.text: Pong, released by Atari in 1972, was an arcade game based on table tennis.
Breakout (1976), Space Invaders (1978) and Asteroids (1979) came out after 1972.
Allan Alcorn created Pong as a training exercise assigned by Nolan Bushnell, a co-founder of Atari.
In arcade Pong each player controls a paddle by turning a knob.
